note: v1, WHOLE (first round, composed from scratch): NUCLEATION, the seed. E1 (posted in motifs.md: D4/8 A4/8. C5/16 G4/4 E4/4. ./4, five notes in 5/4, D with no third) does not get stated, it FORMS. Each of its five notes is its own voice, wide in the field (kalimba D, vibes A, celesta C, glass G, the Game Boy wave E), repeating on its own cycle (9/7/8/6/5 beats) and a little out of tune (up to 0.4 semitone, pulled into tune as the crest nears). The notes drift past each other in scrambled orders until every cycle lands on one shared downbeat at bar 57: the five notes sound in order, in tune, for the first time (a breath, a whispered 'ah' through pvoc, a beat before). Then they lock to 5/4 over the 4/4 floor (they meet every five bars), doubled whole on a glock, with the inversion answering as a canon on ks-harp, the noise hat ticking the cell's own rhythm and a soft 808 in half time. Under it the quartal stack of E1 grows note by note on the GB wave pad (D A, + E, + C, + G), a warm Juno fifth and the NES triangle bass. The last 16 bars (the t1->t2 overlap, flat at 90) let E1 fall: augmented x2, sinking a semitone, filters closing. Tempo 84 -> 90; 265 s. Seeds 0/11: 97.168/97.191 (spectrum 76: a thin 182 Hz band; a louder pad there scored worse). -11 LUFS, TP -1.36. Not heard: read and measured.
next: the crest is small (B only +1 dB over A): a real swell into the convergence; the 182 Hz hole; the voice's breath; the outro sinking more audibly; seam with chirper-one's t2 head

note: v2, PALETTE round (+2.48/+2.46): THE DUST. The noise channel's ticks (nes-noise-hat, an album staple in 4 songs) become a SHEKERE (afro-perc sk): beads around a gourd. The debris orbiting the seed is now made of something you could hold - the 5-in-16 and 7-in-16 Euclids of A and the build, then the cell's own rhythm from the crest - with a clave on each cell's downbeat after the crest (every 5 beats, against the 4/4 floor). And the seam agreed with chirper-one: across the t1->t2 overlap E1 no longer sinks a semitone; it stays on D (augmented x2, filters closing) so t2's Risset bell receives it on D. sections vs v1: w2-w6 -27..-32 dB (the shekere where the hats were), w7/w8 -14/-9 (the outro now on D), w1 untouched. Seeds 0/11: v1 rescored with t2/t4/t5/t6 now in the album 91.031/91.093; the seam fix alone 90.752/91.041; v2 93.515/93.550 (distinct 17 -> 100: the chip tick was what made t1 sound like its neighbours). Out join to t2: spectral 10.2, level 8.2 (unchanged). -11 LUFS. Not heard: read and measured.
